performance.verdict: Campaigns never launched; 5 SOW milestones overdue while GBP goes dark.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages — all due 2026-07-31 — show no completed event, blocking every paid channel.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting, due 2026-08-01, never fired — $0 spend across 28 days confirms campaigns are not live.
GHL shows 102 contacts and 29 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won — intake pipeline exists but no consults are booking; likely a routing/booking-link gap, not an ads problem.
GBP actions fell from an active mid-August peak (9 actions on 2026-08-19) to 0 on the last 4 days (2026-08-31 through 2026-09-03) — a confirmed 3-day zero signal, not noise.
GA4 sessions, Search Console clicks, and IG reach are all 0 across the full 28-day series — no web or organic social signal exists to validate site or pixel readiness before launch.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no ad dollar should move until stack test passes.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones due 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-01 remain uncompleted — Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting. Zero spend and zero leads across 28 days confirm nothing is live. Nacer must confirm completion of each item in writing. Success check: all 5 milestones marked done and LSA verification submitted by 2026-09-11.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL booking link and appointment routing — 29 opportunities exist but 0 appointments booked.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 102 contacts and 29 opportunities created, but 0 appointments are recorded — calendar or booking link is likely broken or unconnected.
